description: A former classroom teacher who keeps rebuilding school at home and wants to loosen that grip.

leaving_behind: detailed lesson plans for every subject
grading the work my own child produces
wants_to_preserve: wide access to books and materials
wants_to_add: genuine choice about what to study
trust that unstructured time is productive
practical_constraints: parent tutors part time in the afternoons
intake.additional_context: The parent taught middle school for eleven years and notices themselves recreating a classroom timetable at the kitchen table.
